name: kilo-bridge
description: Local HTTP bridge that lets the Job Control Center trigger Kilo Code tasks automatically without mouse clicks or keyboard simulation.

kilobridge.host.description: Address the bridge HTTP server binds to.

kilobridge.port.description: Port the bridge HTTP server listens on.

kilobridge.focusViewCommand.description: VS Code command that reveals the Kilo Code chat view.

kilobridge.newTaskCommand.description: VS Code command that starts a new Kilo task (resets the chat).

kilobridge.focusInputCommand.description: VS Code command that focuses the Kilo chat input.

kilobridge.verifyMs.description: Milliseconds the bridge waits for the prompt to be confirmed in Kilo's session database before reporting success.

kilobridge.settleMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after the New Task command so the Kilo chat view has rendered before focusing its input.

kilobridge.sendMode.description: How the prompt is delivered after the Kilo chat input is focused. 'sendkeys': real Ctrl+V + Enter via the Windows SendKeys API into the activated VS Code window (reliable, no screen coordinates). 'commands': try VS Code paste/type commands (editor.action.clipboardPasteAction / webview.paste / type) - may silently no-op when no editor/text-input context exists.

kilobridge.pasteCommands.description: VS Code commands tried (in order) to paste the prompt into the focused Kilo chat input.

kilobridge.sendWithType.description: DEPRECATED - use kilobridge.sendMode. Was: send by simulating Enter through VS Code's `type` command.

kilobridge.sendKeysFallback.description: DEPRECATED - use kilobridge.sendMode. Was: opt-in Windows SendKeys fallback.

kilobridge.maxPromptLength.description: Maximum prompt length accepted by POST /run.

kilobridge.eventMirror.description: Show status events posted by the Job Control Center in the bridge log and status bar.
